outcome: Success rate of treatment for caesarean scar pregnancies (CSPs)
cohort: 200 patients at 4-17 weeks' postmenstrual age with suspected CSP
finding: Trichosanthin (TCS) combined with bilateral UAE and uterine curettage was found to be a safe and effective treatment for CSP, with a success rate of 96.1%, particularly in patients with dangerously high serum β-hCG levels.
